description:
Assess latest package health and adoption: license, downloads, and activity. Provide an unpinned package target; this tool always returns latest known metadata. Registry and source Git repository URLs, when reported, do not establish binary provenance or current availability. Default text returns these URLs, license, description, repository popularity (stars/forks/issues and [ARCHIVED] when applicable), downloads, publish age, latest affected count, and separate package-wide advisory history count. Historical counts are not current-version risk. Use `verbose: true` for additional health and history details. Use metadata directly; missing fields are unknown. Latest and retrieval time do not prove registry freshness or historical release facts.

Load the GitHits guide once per session first (`quick_start` or the `githits-mcp` skill).

format.description: Omit for text. Use json only when code consumes raw fields or text lacks a required field. JSON adds versionCount, downloads.refreshedAt, advisoryHistory.total.

target.description: Latest-only package registry:name, for example npm:express or npm:@types/node; omit version pins. Registries: npm, pypi, hex, crates, nuget, maven, zig, vcpkg, packagist, rubygems, go, swift, pub.

verbose.description: Text only. Adds GitHub language/topics/last-pushed, published-version count, download refresh date, package-wide advisory history (all versions), and recent changes. Latest affected and package-wide history counts are shown separately. Ignored for format=json.

name: pkg_info
